title: Security
description: The system shall ensure secure access to user data and system features, and shall comply with Moodle user roles.

title: Usability
description: The system shall provide a user-friendly interface that improves usability and facilitates the creation of comprehensive exams.

title: Performance
description: The system shall optimize performance to ensure efficient and reliable operation.

title: Compatibility
description: The system shall ensure compatibility with various file formats and systems.

title: Scalability
description: The system shall be scalable to accommodate increasing user demand and data volume.

title: Reliability
description: The system shall ensure reliable operation and minimize downtime.

title: Maintainability
description: The system shall be designed for easy maintenance and updates.
